# Template:Km2

<div class="mw-parser-output">

<a href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Square_kilometre%7C" class="external text" rel="nofollow">km<sup>2</sup></a>

Used for inserting "km<sup>2</sup>" with the link to <a href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Square_kilometre" class="external text" rel="nofollow">Square kilometre</a> since it would be troublesome to type it out manually. This should be <a href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Substitution" class="extiw" title="wikipedia:Wikipedia:Substitution">substituted</a> using **&#123;&#123;subst:Km2&#125;&#125;**.
